notes: Units differ per manager: npm and poetry use days, pnpm and yarn use minutes, bun uses seconds, uv and pip use a timestamp or an ISO 8601 / friendly duration. Always convert from days before writing config. Never lower a value the repo already sets.

alternative.note: Absolute date cutoff. If `before` and `min-release-age` are set in the same config source, `before` wins.

exclude.value_type: string, may be set multiple times; package names or minimatch globs
exclude.note: Exempts only the named package; its own dependencies still follow the policy. Also exempts from `before`.

notes: Internally converted to a `before` date, so `npm config get min-release-age` can print null even when it is set (npm/cli#9199).
If the cooldown blocks `npm audit fix` from installing a patched version, npm keeps the vulnerable version, warns, and exits non-zero (11.18.0+).

npm 12 (12.0.0, 2026-07-08) blocks dependency lifecycle scripts by default unless allowed by the root package.json `allowScripts` field (manage with `npm approve-scripts`). It did not turn min-release-age on by default.

exclude.value_type: string[]; names, globs ('@myorg/*'), or name@version specs ('nx@21.6.5', 'webpack@4.47.0 || 5.102.1')
exclude.note: `pnpm audit --fix` (11.0.0+) adds the minimum patched version of each advisory here so a security fix is not held back by the cooldown.

related_settings.minimumReleaseAgeStrict: true when minimumReleaseAge is explicitly configured, false otherwise. When false, pnpm falls back to a too-young version if nothing in range is old enough.
related_settings.minimumReleaseAgeIgnoreMissingTime: default true (11.0.0+): skip the check when registry metadata lacks `time`.
related_settings.minimumReleaseAgeExcludePrune: default false: prune exclude entries the lockfile no longer resolves.
related_settings.trustPolicy: 'no-downgrade' fails install when a package's trust level drops versus earlier releases. Default 'off'.
related_settings.blockExoticSubdeps: default true since 11.0.0: only direct deps may come from git/tarball URLs.
related_settings.allowBuilds: 11.0.0+: map of package pattern -> boolean for install scripts; replaces onlyBuiltDependencies/neverBuiltDependencies.

notes: In pnpm 11, .npmrc is auth/registry only; pnpm settings live in pnpm-workspace.yaml (works for single-package repos too) or the global config.yaml.

yarn.value_type: integer minutes (4.10.0+) or duration string such as "7d" (4.11.0+); bare numbers are minutes

exclude.value_type: string[]; package descriptors or name globs

notes: Use the integer-minutes form (10080 = 7 days) when the repo may run Yarn 4.10.x.
Yarn berry does not run third-party postinstall scripts unless enableScripts allows it.

exclude.value_type: string[]; bare name exempts all versions, name@version exempts that exact version

notes: install.ignoreScripts = true disables preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts, including for packages listed in trustedDependencies.

uv.value_type: RFC 3339 timestamp, friendly duration ("7 days", "1 week", "24 hours"), or ISO 8601 duration ("P7D"); false disables
uv.min_version_note: 0.9.17 is the minimum for relative durations (the cooldown form). Absolute timestamps are older.

exclude.value_type: table of PACKAGE = timestamp | duration | false
exclude.note: Setting a package to false exempts it entirely; a date/duration gives it its own cutoff.

notes: Compared against the upload time of each distribution file, not the version's first release.
Calendar units (months, years) are not allowed in durations.
Relative values are recorded in uv.lock with a sentinel so the lock does not churn daily (0.11.x).

pip.config_file: pip.conf (pip.ini on Windows); user, global or per-virtualenv. pip has no project-level config file.
pip.value_type: ISO 8601 datetime, or integer-day duration P<n>D
notes: Only effective with indexes that provide upload-time metadata (PyPI does).
Only whole days are accepted in the duration form.
For per-repo enforcement put `--uploaded-prior-to P7D` in the install command or a requirements file workflow, or prefer uv.

exclude.source_exclude_note: Exempts every package from the named sources/index URLs (POETRY_SOLVER_MIN_RELEASE_AGE_EXCLUDE_SOURCE).

notes: A version counts only when all of its known distribution files are at least N days old.
Sources without upload timestamps are not filtered.
